purpose: Perform exactly one read-only native offline observation. Docker Desktop CLI status is retained only as advisory telemetry; admission is decided by two stable snapshots of WSL state, running-distribution inventory, Win32 runtime-process inventory, and bounded Win32 named-pipe absence.

official_semantics.docker_desktop_cli: Docker documents status as displaying whether Docker Desktop is running or stopped. In v5 it is telemetry only because the observed CLI text/exit surface was not sufficiently unambiguous for admission.
official_semantics.wsl: Microsoft documents wsl --list --verbose as reporting installed distributions with Running/Stopped state and --running as listing only currently running distributions.
official_semantics.win32_named_pipe: Microsoft documents WaitNamedPipeW as returning zero when no instance is available and GetLastError as the extended error surface; when no instance exists it returns immediately regardless of timeout.

allowed_command_sequence: snapshot A: PowerShell fail-stop Win32_Process CIM inventory returning exact allowlisted names only
snapshot B stability barrier: PowerShell fail-stop Win32_Process CIM inventory returning exact allowlisted names only
non_command_observations: In each snapshot, WaitNamedPipeW with an explicit 1 millisecond bound must return false with Win32 ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND (2) for dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; no pipe connection is opened.

admission_conditions.docker_desktop_status_lane: advisory telemetry only; classification is recorded but has neither admit nor veto authority in v5
admission_conditions.wsl_inventory: strict complete parse; docker-desktop exists and is Stopped; every listed distribution is Stopped
admission_conditions.wsl_running_inventory: strict complete quiet parse with zero running distribution names
admission_conditions.desktop_linux_named_pipe: Two independent 1 millisecond WaitNamedPipeW observations must return false with Win32 ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND (2); no pipe connection is opened
admission_conditions.docker_runtime_process_inventory: Win32_Process CIM enumeration must complete under ErrorAction Stop before JSON emission; strict JSON parse must contain zero allowlisted runtime process names
admission_conditions.stability_barrier: snapshots A and B must each pass all four native lanes and produce identical strict WSL and process inventories; named-pipe absence must be observed in both snapshots
admission_conditions.attempt003_pre_gate_replay: A PASS observation is insufficient by itself; the separately audited attempt-003 runner must replay the offline-equivalent pre-gate immediately before its one start attempt.

forbidden: container create, run, stop, remove or exec
failure_policy: Any required native-lane command timeout, spawn error, incomplete parser, Unicode category-C evidence character, running WSL distribution, incomplete process enumeration, remaining target runtime process, named-pipe availability or non-ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND result, interpreter flag, instability, or output ambiguity fails closed. Docker Desktop status telemetry cannot admit or veto. No retry and no state mutation.
